findings.what: insertContactMessage/getDb errors are not caught; a DB failure throws to the error boundary and the user's form input is lost with no field-level feedback
Relies on node:sqlite with no engines field in package.json; the default DB path 'data/app.db' (line 27) is relative to cwd and fails on read-only/serverless filesystems
Length limits count UTF-16 code units rather than characters, so astral-plane characters such as emoji count as 2
Public form has no rate limiting or spam protection, allowing unbounded inserts into contact_messages
